title: Learning history without getting bored is possible.
text: Simply wonderful, everything was very enjoyable for us and we learned a lot (and look, we are from Granada all our lives). And all this thanks to Cintia (or Cynthia) because she has a way of telling things that I have rarely seen and also with a professionalism and knowledge of the topics of 10. 100% recommended.
author: Biotilus
